title: Orlando Family Private Tour: Downtown Wonders
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a private, exclusive tour with your own local guide. Embark on an urban adventure with “Orlando Family Explorer: A Walk Through Downtown Wonders”. This tour is perfect for families looking to discover the heart of Orlando. Start at the SunTrust Center Parking, a central point to begin your exploration. Stroll to Church Street Station, an iconic historic site full of charm. Next, admire the exterior of the Grand Bohemian Hotel Orlando, a masterpiece of art and architecture. Pass by the Orlando City Clerk’s office, a key landmark in the city’s administrative heart. Conclude your tour at the Terrace Gallery, located in the same building as the City Clerk, known for its public art displays. This 2-hour walking tour is a delightful way to experience Orlando’s downtown highlights, suitable for the whole family.
